newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rato gives positive reading on Feb jobless.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato gives positive reading on Feb jobless.

text.p: Spain's Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato gave a positive reading to the latest unemployment data, which he said on Monday was lower than the average February rate for the past 15 years.
The unemployment rate rose to 14.11 percent in February from 14.07 percent in January and 15.44 percent in February 1996.

Speaking to journalists at a conference, Rato said the number of people signing off jobless benefits "showed that the intensity of job creation is showing through at the moment, and, above all, we'll start reducing unemployment very soon."
